extensionDescription.message: Fills, shows and saves logins from the desktop password manager. Keeps no passwords itself: every one comes from the app, which asks you to confirm before the browser gets it.

notRunningText.message: Open the password manager on this computer and turn on Settings → Browser extension. Then click this button again.

lockedText.message: Unlock it in the app. To fill while it is locked, turn on Settings → Browser extension → Fill with Windows Hello while the vault is locked.

insecureText.message: Anything typed here can be read on the way, so logins are not filled on it.

notAWebsiteText.message: Logins are filled on websites only.

noLoginsTitle.message: No login saved for this site

noLoginsText.message: A login is offered only on the exact site saved in it ($ORIGIN$). Check the website of the item in the app if you expected one.

pinText.message: Locked. Your PIN opens it for this fill only.

passwordText.message: Locked. Your item password opens it for this fill only.

wrongCheck.message: That isn't it. $LEFT$ tries left before the vault locks.

wrongCheckLast.message: That isn't it. One more wrong try locks the vault.

pairText.message: Do this once. Connect opens the password manager, where you type your master password. No password is typed or kept here.

pairWaitText.message: The password manager shows a code too. Connect there with your master password only if it is this same code. This window carries on by itself once you connect.

itemLockedText.message: This login is behind the item lock, which asks for your master password. Open it in the app, then try again. To open logins from here, choose a PIN in the app's Settings → Item lock.

pageChanged.message: The page changed before it was filled. Nothing was typed.

noFields.message: No sign-in fields were found on this page. Nothing was typed.

notSavedText.message: The app could not write it to the vault file (it was changed elsewhere, or the disk refused). Nothing was kept. Try again in a moment.

chooseField.message: This page has more than one sign-in form. Click into the one to fill, then try again. Nothing was typed.

insecureForm.message: This form sends what is typed without encryption (http). Nothing was typed.

filledUsername.message: Username filled. Continue to the password step, then click the button again.

failed.message: That didn't work. Nothing was typed.

goneTitle.message: That login is no longer there

goneText.message: It was removed or changed in the app. Close this window and open it again.

turnedOffText.message: Saving logins from the browser, or passkeys, is off in the app: Settings, Browser extension.

vaultEmpty.message: No logins in this vault yet. Add one in the app, or sign in to a site and choose Save.

copiedSecret.message: Copied by the app. The clipboard is cleared in $SECONDS$ seconds.

entryAsks.message: Locked. Showing, copying or filling it asks for $CHECK$.

saveTitle.message: Save this login to your vault?

saveFailed.message: Not saved. Check that the app is running, then try again.

savedQueued.message: Saved. It goes into your vault the next time you unlock it.

saveGone.message: Not saved: this offer is no longer waiting. Sign in again to be asked again.

updateChangedSince.message: Not updated: this login was changed in Vault since. Nothing was replaced.

badAnswerText.message: An answer reached the browser changed on the way from Vault, so nothing in it was used. If you didn't install something that connects to browsers, check this computer, then turn the extension setting in Vault off and on again.

oldAppText.message: The Vault app on this computer is older than this extension and didn't understand it. In Vault, open Settings, About, and choose Check for updates, then try again.

outdatedText.message: Vault accepts no extension this old, so it answers nothing it asks. In Vault, open Settings → Browser extension and choose Add to a browser: it writes the newest extension into its folder. Then reload the extension on the browser's extensions page, or restart the browser.

changedSinceText.message: This login was changed in Vault after the update was offered (edited, or by a sync). Nothing was replaced. Sign in again to be asked again.

offerText.message: You signed in as $USERNAME$. Save this login to your vault?

genNote.message: Made by the app. Copy is done by the app too: out of clipboard history and cleared after a while.

genImpossible.message: Choose at least one kind of character.

nameHint.message: The site's name when left empty

newSiteError.message: Type the site's address, for example example.com. Only https sites.

newExists.message: A login with this username is already saved for this site.

suggestNote.message: $LENGTH$ characters, fitting this site's rules. You'll be asked to save the login after you sign up.

pairAgainTitle.message: The app doesn't know this extension any more

pairAgainText.message: It was disconnected in the app, or another vault is open there. Connect again: the app asks for your master password.

noCodeField.message: No field for a one-time code on this page

chooseCodeField.message: This page asks for a one-time code in more than one form. Click into the one to fill, then try again. Nothing was typed.

offerUpdateText.message: You signed in as $USERNAME$ with another password. Update the one saved?

updatedToast.message: Password updated. The old one is in the login's history.

prefsSaving.message: Vault offers to save passwords, not the browser

prefsSavingHint.message: On, Vault offers to save or update a login after you sign in, and the browser's own “Offer to save passwords and passkeys” is off (the browser's settings say Vault controls it). Off, Vault keeps and offers nothing you type into sign-in forms, and the browser's own saving is back. Filling from Vault works either way.

prefsSavingOther.message: Another extension controls this browser setting. Turn that one off to let Vault have it.

prefsSavingPolicy.message: Your organization controls this browser setting.

passkeyGetTitle.message: Sign in with a passkey saved in Vault

passkeyCreateText.message: Vault keeps it with your login for this site. The site gets only its public half, and you sign in with it from Vault next time.

passkeyLockedGet.message: Vault is locked. Unlock it in the app, then try again to sign in with a passkey saved there.

passkeyLockedCreate.message: Vault is locked. Unlock it in the app, then try again to save the passkey there.

passkeyLockedRow.message: Asks for the item lock first

passkeyPin.message: This login is locked. Your PIN opens it for this passkey only.

passkeyItemPassword.message: This login is locked. Your item password opens it for this passkey only.

passkeyOpenInApp.message: This login is locked. Open it in the app, then choose it here again.

passkeyPageChanged.message: The page changed meanwhile, so nothing was sent to it.

passkeyFailed.message: Vault couldn't do that. Try again, or use another device.

passkeyMadeNotSent.message: Vault saved the passkey, but the page changed or stopped waiting before it got it, so the site can't use it. You can delete it from this site's login in the app, then try again on the page.

passkeyMadeNotSentReplaced.message: Vault saved the passkey, but the page changed or stopped waiting before it got it, so the site can't use it. It took the place of the passkey saved before for this account, which is no longer in Vault: sign in to the site another way (your password), then make a passkey again.

prefsPasskeys.message: Vault keeps passkeys, not the browser

prefsPasskeysHint.message: When a site makes or asks for a passkey, Vault offers its own: in a window of its own, or under the sign-in field when the site suggests passkeys there. Choose “Use another device” in the window for a phone or security key. Turned off, the browser handles passkeys as before.

prefsAgent.message: An AI agent or a program is using this browser

prefsAgentHint.message: On, Vault shows nothing in web pages: no list under sign-in fields, no offer to save there, no passkeys among a field's suggestions. Fill, save and copy from this window instead, which asks as usual. What a page holds is within an agent's reach, and a page can hide instructions for it. Vault does this by itself when the browser says a program drives it.

prefsAgentAutomated.message: This browser says a program is driving it: Vault shows nothing in pages, whatever this box says.

lockTitle.message: Lock the vault in Vault, as its Lock now does

setupTitle.message: Set up Windows Hello or a PIN in Vault

setupText.message: Vault asks for Windows Hello or a PIN before the browser gets a password, a code or a passkey, and neither is set up yet. In Vault, open Settings → Browser extension and set one up, then try again.

setupShort.message: Vault asks for Windows Hello or a PIN before the browser gets a password, and neither is set up. Set one up in Vault: Settings → Browser extension.

helloRefusedTitle.message: Windows Hello didn't confirm it's you

helloRefusedText.message: Nothing was shown, copied or filled. Try again, and confirm in the Windows Hello window.

siteAsksHello.message: Filling asks for Windows Hello, each time.

siteAsksPin.message: Filling asks for your PIN, each time.

siteAsksPassword.message: Filling asks for your item password, each time.

siteAsksApp.message: These logins are behind the item lock, which only your master password opens, in Vault.

vaultAsksHello.message: Showing, copying or filling a password asks for Windows Hello, each time.

vaultAsksPin.message: Showing, copying or filling a password asks for your PIN, each time.

vaultAsksPassword.message: Showing, copying or filling a password asks for your item password, each time.

vaultAsksApp.message: These logins are behind the item lock, which only your master password opens, in Vault.

someAskHello.message: Logins with a fingerprint ask for Windows Hello first.

someAskPin.message: Logins with a padlock ask for your PIN first.

someAskPassword.message: Logins with a padlock ask for your item password first.

someAskApp.message: Logins with a padlock are behind the item lock: open them in Vault first.

entryAsksHello.message: Showing, copying or filling asks for Windows Hello, each time.

entryAsksPin.message: Showing, copying or filling asks for your PIN, each time.

entryAsksPassword.message: Showing, copying or filling asks for your item password, each time.

genFailed.message: The app couldn't make a password. Try again.

updateText.message: Version $VERSION$ of this extension is ready.

updateManual.message: Vault has a newer version of this extension ($VERSION$). The steps to install it are in Vault: Settings → Browser extension.

prefsInApp.message: What the extension may do, and what Vault asks for before the browser gets a password, are set in Vault: Settings → Browser extension.

lockedTextPin.message: Unlock it in the app, then open this window again. The generator works while it is locked.

setupTextPin.message: Vault asks for a PIN before the browser gets a password, a code or a passkey, and none is set yet. In Vault, open Settings → Browser extension and choose one, then try again.

setupShortPin.message: Vault asks for a PIN before the browser gets a password, and none is set. Choose one in Vault: Settings → Browser extension.

codesEmptyText.message: Logins with a one-time code (two-step sign-in) are listed here. Add one to a login in Vault: edit it, then One-time code.

codesAsksHello.message: Showing, copying or filling a code asks for Windows Hello, each time.

codesAsksPin.message: Showing, copying or filling a code asks for your PIN, each time.

codesAsksPassword.message: Showing, copying or filling a code asks for your item password, each time.

codesAsksApp.message: These logins are behind the item lock, which only your master password opens, in Vault.

lookalikeText.message: This page is $PAGE$. It looks like $SITE$, where you have a login, but it is another site: Vault fills nothing here.

pastedText.message: This page is $PAGE$, not $SITE$. Don't send it unless you use the same password here on purpose.

pastedLookalike.message: This page is $PAGE$: it only looks like $SITE$. Don't sign in here.

sentText.message: It went to $PAGE$. If you didn't mean to, change it on $SITE$ now.

sentLookalike.message: $PAGE$ only looks like $SITE$. Change that password on $SITE$ now, typing its address yourself.

kitTitle.message: Never type your emergency kit's keys into a website

kitText.message: Vault never asks for your Secret Key or a recovery part in a page: whoever asks for them wants to open your vault. The paste was stopped.

kitTypedText.message: Vault never asks for your Secret Key or a recovery part in a page: whoever asks for them wants to open your vault. It was taken out of the field.

saveLookalike.message: This site only looks like $SITE$, where you have a login.

ruleNeverSave.message: Never offer to save a login here

ruleChanged.message: Rule changed for $ONE$. Vault shows it in Settings.

ruleNotChanged.message: The rule couldn't be changed. Try again in the app: Settings, Browser extension.

siteRuleText.message: Your rule for this site in Vault says no to this. Change it under Rules for this site, or in the app: Settings, Browser extension, Site rules.

cardFrameAsk.message: This page's card fields are in a frame of $ONE$. Fill cards there on this site?

cardFramePartly.message: Some card fields are in a frame of $ONE$. Fill cards there too on this site?

cardFrameFailed.message: The card wasn't filled. Use the extension's window, or type it.

cardNoFields.message: No card fields found on this page.

cardFrameWindowAsk.message: This page's card fields are in a frame of $ONE$. Allow cards there on this site, then fill again?

saveLeaked.message: This password turned up in data breaches $ONE$ times. Save it, then change it on the site.

saveReusedOne.message: Another login in Vault has this password: a leak of one exposes both.

saveReused.message: $ONE$ other logins in Vault have this password: a leak of one exposes them all.
